name: Evidence Mapping
description: Tracing a compliance control (CIS, SOC 2, HIPAA, or a cyber-insurance questionnaire line item) to concrete, retrievable tool evidence: which vendor family can observe what — CIPP for live M365/Entra configuration, Liongard for point-in-time infrastructure state, IT Glue/Hudu for documentation — a representative control-to-tool-call map, and the evidentiary weights that separate Configured from Documented, Contradicted, and Unable to Verify.
